run_pipeline_image_to_video: run the HunyuanVideoImageToVideoPipeline to generate a video from a reference image and text prompt
encode_prompt_with_image: encode a text prompt with an image using LLaVA text encoder and CLIP pooled embeddings for image-to-video generation
prepare_image_latents: prepare image latents by encoding a reference image through the VAE and blending with random noise for video generation
expand_input_ids_with_image_tokens: expand text input IDs by replacing image placeholder tokens with expanded image embedding token sequences
retrieve_timesteps: retrieve scheduler timesteps from either num_inference_steps, custom timesteps list, or custom sigmas list
